# pekko-streams-ingest

> Line-oriented file ingestion on Pekko Streams with backpressure from a slow sink, byte-bounded batches, a dead-letter channel and resumable offset checkpoints Scala library `io.github.trysac:pekko-streams-ingest`, package
> `io.github.trysac.pekko_streams_ingest`, MIT licensed, Scala 3 on Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
